title: Lasers
description: An excited atom struck by a photon of the right colour gives off a second, identical one. Pump a crystal full of excited atoms between two mirrors and the light builds on itself: one colour, one direction, in step. Unlocks the Laser Rod, Laser Head and Faraday Isolator.

puzzle.goal: A laser gives off light of one wavelength λ. Each photon carries an energy set by the quantum of action h and the speed of light c. Write the energy E of one photon.
puzzle.name: Planck relation for light
puzzle.ask: Find E in electronvolts for a neodymium laser, L = @{L} m (h = 6.626e-34 J·s, c = 2.998e8 m/s; 1 eV = 1.602e-19 J).
puzzle.method: A photon's energy is hν, and its frequency is c over its wavelength.
